submenu.title: btop
submenu.help: Interactive resource monitor. CPU, memory, disk, network at a glance.

submenu.title: htop
submenu.help: Classic interactive process viewer. Kill, renice, and filter processes.

submenu.title: CPU info
submenu.help: Show CPU architecture, cores, cache, and frequency details.

submenu.title: Memory usage
submenu.help: Show RAM and swap usage in human-readable form plus vmstat summary.

submenu.title: Hardware summary
submenu.help: Full hardware overview: CPU, RAM, disks, network, audio. Requires inxi.

submenu.title: Uptime & load
submenu.help: System uptime, load averages, and logged-in users.

submenu.title: Temperatures
submenu.help: CPU and motherboard temperatures via lm-sensors. Run sensors-detect first if blank.

submenu.title: USB devices
submenu.help: List all connected USB devices with verbose details.

submenu.title: PCI devices
submenu.help: List PCI/PCIe devices: graphics card, sound, network controllers etc.

title: Network
help: Network status, configuration, and diagnostic tools.

submenu.title: nmtui
submenu.help: NetworkManager text UI. Connect to wifi, edit connections, set hostname.

submenu.title: Connection status
submenu.cmd: nmcli device status && echo '' && nmcli connection show --active
submenu.help: Show all network devices and currently active connections.

submenu.title: IP addresses
submenu.help: Show all network interfaces and their assigned IP addresses.

submenu.title: Routing table
submenu.help: Display the kernel routing table.

submenu.title: DNS lookup
submenu.cmd: read -p 'Host to resolve: ' h && dig +short $h && echo '' && dig +short -x $(dig +short $h | head -1)
submenu.help: Forward and reverse DNS lookup for any hostname.

submenu.title: Ping gateway
submenu.help: Ping your default gateway 5 times to check local connectivity.

submenu.title: Open ports
submenu.help: List all listening TCP and UDP ports with the process using them.

submenu.title: Bandwidth monitor
submenu.help: Real-time per-interface bandwidth monitor. Requires bmon.

submenu.title: Trace route
submenu.help: Trace the network path to a remote host hop by hop.

submenu.title: Firewall status
submenu.help: Show current UFW firewall rules and status.

title: Disk & Files
help: Disk usage, filesystem, and file management tools.

submenu.title: Disk usage (ncdu)
submenu.help: Interactive disk usage browser. Navigate with arrows, delete with d. Requires ncdu.

submenu.title: Filesystem overview
submenu.help: Show all mounted filesystems, their type, size, used, and available space.

submenu.title: Block devices
submenu.help: Tree view of all block devices: disks, partitions, loop devices.

submenu.title: SMART status
submenu.cmd: lsblk -dno NAME | grep -E 'sd|nvme' | while read d; do echo "--- /dev/$d ---"; sudo smartctl -H /dev/$d; done
submenu.help: Check SMART health status for all drives. Requires smartmontools.

submenu.title: Mount a device
submenu.cmd: lsblk && echo '' && read -p 'Device (e.g. sdb1): ' d && read -p 'Mount point: ' m && sudo mount /dev/$d $m && echo Mounted.
submenu.help: List block devices then mount a chosen device to a path.

submenu.title: Unmount a device
submenu.cmd: lsblk && echo '' && read -p 'Mount point to unmount: ' m && sudo umount $m && echo Done.
submenu.help: Unmount a filesystem by its mount point.

submenu.title: Find large files
submenu.cmd: read -p 'Search under (default /home): ' d && find ${d:-/home} -type f -printf '%s %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -30 | awk '{printf "%-10s %s\n", $1/1024/1024 "MB", $2}' | less
submenu.help: Find the 30 largest files under a given directory.

submenu.title: Midnight Commander
submenu.help: Two-pane file manager with built-in viewer and editor. Requires mc.

submenu.title: Update package list
submenu.help: Refresh the APT package index from all configured sources.

submenu.title: Upgrade all packages
submenu.cmd: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade
submenu.help: Update package list then upgrade all installed packages.

submenu.title: Full upgrade
submenu.cmd: sudo apt update && sudo apt full-upgrade
submenu.help: Like upgrade but also handles changing dependencies and removes obsolete packages.

submenu.title: Install a package
submenu.cmd: read -p 'Package name: ' p && sudo apt install $p
submenu.help: Install a package by name.

submenu.title: Remove a package
submenu.cmd: read -p 'Package to remove: ' p && sudo apt remove $p
submenu.help: Remove a package but keep its configuration files.

submenu.title: Purge a package
submenu.cmd: read -p 'Package to purge: ' p && sudo apt purge $p
submenu.help: Remove a package and delete its configuration files.

submenu.title: Search packages
submenu.cmd: read -p 'Search term: ' q && apt-cache search $q | less
submenu.help: Search APT for packages matching a keyword.

submenu.title: Show package info
submenu.cmd: read -p 'Package name: ' p && apt-cache show $p | less
submenu.help: Display detailed info about a package: version, deps, description.

submenu.title: List installed
submenu.help: List all currently installed packages.

submenu.title: Autoremove
submenu.help: Remove packages that were installed as dependencies but are no longer needed.

submenu.title: Clean cache
submenu.cmd: sudo apt clean && sudo apt autoclean
submenu.help: Delete downloaded package files from the APT cache to free disk space.

title: Logs & Diagnostics
help: System logs, journal, and diagnostic tools.

submenu.title: journalctl (live)
submenu.help: Follow the systemd journal live. Shows new log entries as they arrive.

submenu.title: journalctl (boot)
submenu.help: Show all log entries from the current boot.

submenu.title: journalctl (errors)
submenu.help: Show only error-level and above messages from the current boot.

submenu.title: Previous boot log
submenu.help: Show journal from the previous boot. Useful after a crash or unexpected reboot.

submenu.title: Kernel ring buffer
submenu.help: Show kernel messages with human-readable timestamps. Good for hardware issues.

submenu.title: Failed services
submenu.help: List all systemd units that are currently in a failed state.

submenu.title: Service status
submenu.cmd: read -p 'Service name: ' s && systemctl status $s | less
submenu.help: Check the status and recent log output of any systemd service.

submenu.title: Auth log
submenu.help: Show SSH login attempts and authentication events from this boot.

submenu.title: Disk errors
submenu.help: Filter kernel journal for disk-related errors and ATA messages.

submenu.title: Last logins
submenu.help: Show the 30 most recent user logins and reboots.
